🐝 Welcome to NotesBee — Your Notes, Your Chats, Your Space!

This is Day $day of my daily dev journey where I document the process of building, designing, and improving NotesBee from scratch.

📱 What is NotesBee?
NotesBee is an Android productivity app designed to keep your private thoughts, daily checklists, and saved WhatsApp chat exports organized in one secure place.

✨ Key Features:
🔒 Private notes with password protection
🤖 AI-assisted note drafting & formatting
💬 Save & read exported WhatsApp conversations offline
🔍 Instant search across notes and saved chats
🎨 Custom backgrounds, themes, and clean aesthetics
📝 Quick capture for daily ideas and todos

🚀 Download NotesBee on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sr.notesbee
